caption: The drawing depicts a long, double-breasted overcoat with wide lapels, a high collar, and buttoned cuffs. The overcoat is decorated with an intricate floral pattern consisting of winding green vines and leaves, as well as clusters of flowers in shades of purple, pink, yellow, and blue distributed throughout the fabric. The garment features a matching fabric belt that cinches at the waist and is fastened with a buckle. The coat is illustrated on a lightly sketched mannequin, with an inner ruffled shirt and cravat visible at the neckline in grayish-white tones. The background is plain and consists of a light beige or off-white paper with a rectangular border drawn in pencil or ink around the composition. The lines of the coat and the floral patterning are delicately rendered with colored pencils or watercolors, providing a soft and transparent quality to the illustration.
title: Man's Dressing Gown
